**Werengani izi mokweza kwa anthu a pa msonkhano musanajambule chithunzi.**
Tijambula chithunzi chimodzi cha msonkhano uwu. Chithunzichi chikusonyeza kuti msonkhano unachitikadi.
Kukhala mu chithunzichi ndi kwaufulu. Ngati simukufuna kukhala mu chithunzichi, mukhoza kuchokamo nthawi ina iliyonse, ngakhale nditakufunsani kale. Simuyenera kupereka chifukwa, ndipo palibe choipa chomwe chidzakuchitikireni chifukwa cha zimenezo.
Chithunzichi ndi kaundula wa msonkhanowu ndi zachinsinsi. Timalemba chabe kuchuluka kwa anthu amene anabwera ndi amene anatenga nawo mbali. Sitilemba dzina la munthu aliyense, choncho palibe yankho la pano lomwe limamangiriridwa kwa munthu.
Chithunzichi ndi kaundulayu sizikhala ndi ine. Misonkhano ina imayang'aniridwanso ndi Partner Trainer.

**Ŵazgani ivi mwakukwezga ku ŵanthu ŵa pa ungano pambere mundatore chithuzi.**
Titorenge chithuzi chimoza cha ungano uwu. Chithuzi ichi chikulongora kuti ungano ukachitikadi.
Kuŵa mu chithuzi ichi ntchakukhumba kwinu, palije kuchichizgika. Usange mukukhumba yayi kuŵa mu chithuzi, mungafumamo nyengo yiliyose, nanga para nafumba kale. Mukwenera kupeleka chifukwa yayi, ndipo palije chiheni icho chichitikenge kwa imwe chifukwa cha ichi.
Chithuzi ichi na kalembero ka ungano uwu ni vyachisisi. Tikulemba pera unandi wa ŵanthu awo ŵakiza na awo ŵakatorapo lwande. Tikulemba zina la munthu waliyose yayi, ntheura palije zgoro la pano ilo likukakikira ku munthu.
Chithuzi ichi na kalembero aka vikukhala na ine yayi.
